investigation_notes.Decoded Script Summary: The encoded PowerShell command defines a function that resolves a target path and checks whether the underlying drive format is NTFS to determine support for alternate data streams (uses System.IO.DriveInfo and Resolve-Path). There are no external IPs or network indicators present in the scriptblock and no file path was provided in the alert metadata.
investigation_notes.Description: The alert was triggered by an encoded PowerShell command executed by service account svc_backup_veeam on SRV-APPS-PRD02 which decodes to a function that checks NTFS support for alternate data streams. There is no file path, no external IP indicators, and no historical or similar alerts tied to this behavior, and the executing account appears to be a legitimate backup service account performing a benign drive/format check. Given the script intent, lack of malicious indicators, and known service account context, this is assessed as Low Priority.
